verdict.rationale: The only openness evidence is that Twilio offers open-sourced reference collaboration apps for iOS, Android, and ReactJS. Those are sample applications built on the service, not the source of Twilio Video itself, and no license is named. Nothing in the pack shows the SDKs or the service source are readable under an open license, so this counts only as adjacent support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
